purpose: Operational security/privacy incident-routing matrix for the 27 configured Tailmance markets, derived from the internally approved official-source legal matrix. It does not claim regulator certification and keeps live incident facts conditional.
default_release_effect: Source-level incident legal review PASS. At incident time, exact country/subnational context and legal clock are resolved from the current official-source matrix; unknown live facts fail closed.

internal_response_targets.clock_rule: Legal clocks vary by jurisdiction and may start on awareness, detection, determination, discovery, or a sector-specific event; never assume a universal 72-hour clock.
internal_response_targets.decision_rule: Use the shortest applicable clock supported by the current internal official-source incident matrix while incident classification/applicability review runs in parallel; uncertainty never means no notification duty.

AE.canonical_screening_note: Official Federal Decree-Law No. 45/2021 Article 9 requires a controller, when aware of a breach prejudicing privacy, confidentiality or security, to notify the Bureau and affected data subjects as prescribed; the Decree-Law leaves the specific period/measures to Executive Regulations. No unsupported fixed-hour deadline is asserted. DIFC/ADGM/free-zone applicability remains separate.
AE.authority_or_route: UAE Data Office/Bureau under Federal Decree-Law No. 45/2021 Article 9 for onshore federal PDPL scope; separately resolve DIFC and ADGM.

authority_notification.trigger: Controller becomes aware of a personal-data breach/violation that would prejudice privacy, confidentiality or security; do not invent a fixed 72-hour federal deadline.

data_subject_notification.trigger: Article 9 requires affected data-subject notice where the breach would prejudice privacy/confidentiality/security, subject to the applicable measures and timing.

recordkeeping.minimum: Preserve breach nature/cause, approximate records/subjects, DPO details, expected effects, corrective actions, investigation and notice evidence.

AE.special_cyber_reporting: Federal PDPL, DIFC, ADGM and any cybersecurity/sector reporting must be scoped separately.
AE.conditional_scope: Federal UAE screening is not a substitute for DIFC/ADGM/free-zone applicability review.

CN.conditional_scope: The four-hour CAC route is incident/operator-class dependent and coexists with PIPL personal-information duties.

As of 30 Sep 2026, do not treat the future DPDP breach regime as already in force; keep CERT-In and any other current applicable law/sector duties operationally separate and controlled by internal exact-scope applicability review.

RU.canonical_screening_note: The Official Publication of Legal Acts records Federal Law No. 266-FZ of 14 July 2022 amending Federal Law No. 152-FZ on Personal Data. Article 21(3.1), introduced by that amendment, establishes a 24-hour initial notice to the authorized authority after discovery of a qualifying unlawful or accidental personal-data transfer/provision/distribution/access incident, followed within 72 hours by internal-investigation results. The current consolidated Article 21 was rechecked on 2026-09-30. Exact Tailmance controller/operator scope, direct data-subject duties, sector/cyber overlays, filing mechanics and retention remain controlled by internal exact-scope applicability review before release.
RU.authority_or_route: Roskomnadzor / the authorized personal-data protection authority under Federal Law No. 152-FZ, subject to controller/operator applicability and any parallel cybersecurity duties.

authority_notification.trigger: Federal Law No. 152-FZ Article 21(3.1), introduced by Federal Law No. 266-FZ, requires an initial authority notice within 24 hours after discovering an unlawful or accidental transfer/provision/distribution/access incident that violates data-subject rights, followed within 72 hours by the internal-investigation results and available responsible-person information.

data_subject_notification.trigger: Do not infer a universal affected-person notice clock from Article 21(3.1); resolve any direct data-subject, sector or cybersecurity notice duty for the incident.

recordkeeping.minimum: Preserve discovery chronology, initial 24-hour authority notice, 72-hour internal investigation, containment/remediation, responsible-person findings where available and all internal legal/applicability decisions.

RU.special_cyber_reporting: Assess personal-data incident notification separately from Russian information-security, critical-information-infrastructure, telecom/platform or other sector reporting duties; the shortest confirmed applicable clock governs operational escalation.
RU.conditional_scope: Tailmance production use in RU remains fail-closed until controller/processor, establishment, data-subject, sector and any subnational/special-jurisdiction applicability are approved.
